verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਕਰਿ ਉਧਰੀ ਪੂਤਨਾ ਵਿਹੁ ਪੀਆਲਣੁ ਕੰਮੁ ਨ ਚੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: jekar udharee pootanaa vih peeaalan ka(n)m na cha(n)gaa|

en.bdb: If even Pfitana (female demon) got liberated that does not mean that poisoning some one is a good act.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਨਿਕਾ ਉਧਰੀ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਲਈਐ ਪੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: ganikaa udharee aakheeaai par ghar jai na lieeaai pa(n)gaa|

en.bdb: Gariika (a prostitute) was liberated but one should not enter other's house and invite trouble.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਲਮੀਕੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ਮਾਰੈ ਵਾਟ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: baalameek nisataariaa maarai vaaT na hoi nisa(n)gaa|

en.bdb: Since Valmlici got blest, one should not adopt the way of highway robbery.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫੰਧਿਕ ਉਧਰੈ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਫੜੀਐ ਟੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: fa(n)dhik udharai aakheean faahee pai na faReeaai Ta(n)gaa|

en.bdb: One bird catcher is also said to be liberated, but we should not catch hold of the leg of others by using snares.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕਾਸਾਈ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਜੀਆ ਘਾਇ ਨ ਖਾਈਐ ਭੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: je kaasaiee udhariaa jeeaa ghai na khaieeaai bha(n)gaa|

en.bdb: If Sadhana, the butcher got across (the world ocean), we should not put ourselves to harm by killing others.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਲੋਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ।
verses.translit_en: paar utaarai bohithaa suinaa loh naahee ik ra(n)gaa|

en.bdb: Ship takes across both iron and gold but still their forms and colours are not the same.
In fact, living on such hopes is a bad life style.
